name: SpaceX_EA_Delete_StopLoss
summary: This EA provides a GUI button labeled 'DELETE SL_TP' that removes stop loss and take profit levels from all open positions when clicked. It iterates through all positions and modifies each to set SL and TP to zero, effectively removing all protection levels. The EA does not open any trades on its own.
summary_zh: 该EA提供一个名为'DELETE SL_TP'的GUI按钮，点击后移除所有持仓的止损和止盈水平。它遍历所有持仓并将每笔仓位的止损和止盈设置为零，从而移除所有保护水平。该EA本身不进行任何开仓操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个纯工具型EA，不具备任何交易策略逻辑。它没有入场条件，不会根据市场信号开仓或平仓。其核心功能是通过按钮一键移除所有持仓的止损和止盈，属于仓位管理辅助工具。在仓位管理方面，它只做移除止损止盈的操作，不涉及仓位大小调整或加减仓。资金管理方面完全缺失，没有任何风险控制机制。值得注意的是，移除止损止盈是一个高风险操作，会导致所有持仓失去保护，面临无限亏损风险。代码中虽然有错误标志变量，但并未对错误进行任何处理或提示用户。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility tool with no trading strategy logic whatsoever. It has no entry conditions and does not open or close positions based on market signals. Its core function is to remove stop loss and take profit levels from all open positions via a single button click, functioning as a position management aid. Regarding position management, it only performs the operation of removing SL/TP without any position sizing adjustments or scaling. Money management is completely absent with no risk control mechanisms in place. Critically, removing stop loss and take profit is a high-risk operation that leaves all positions unprotected and exposed to unlimited loss potential. Although the code includes an error flag variable, it does not perform any error handling or user notification when modification fails.
pros: 一键移除所有持仓的止损止盈，操作便捷
使用MQL5标准库的CAppDialog和CButton控件，GUI框架规范
代码结构清晰，类封装合理，遵循MQL5面向对象编程规范
pros_en: One-click removal of SL/TP from all positions for convenience
Uses standard MQL5 CAppDialog and CButton controls with proper GUI framework conventions
Clean code structure with reasonable class encapsulation following MQL5 OOP standards
cons: 移除止损止盈使持仓完全暴露于无限风险中，极度危险
错误处理不完善：errors变量被设置但从未检查或反馈给用户
没有确认对话框，一键操作可能误触导致严重后果
对所有品种的所有持仓无差别操作，缺乏过滤功能
OnTick函数为空，但EA仍需持续运行消耗资源
cons_en: Removing SL/TP exposes all positions to unlimited risk, extremely dangerous
Poor error handling: the errors variable is set but never checked or reported to the user
No confirmation dialog — a single click could trigger catastrophic unintended consequences
Operates on all positions across all symbols indiscriminately without filtering capability
OnTick function is empty yet the EA must run continuously consuming resources
improvements: 添加确认对话框，防止误触导致止损止盈被意外移除
增加错误反馈机制，操作失败时通过Alert或图表注释通知用户
添加品种过滤或持仓筛选功能，允许选择性移除止损止盈
improvements_en: Add a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental SL/TP removal from misclicks
Implement error feedback mechanism to notify users via Alert or chart comments when operations fail
Add symbol filtering or position selection to allow selective SL/TP removal

risk_points: 移除止损止盈使所有持仓失去风险保护，可能面临无限亏损
无确认机制，误触按钮即可移除所有保护
错误不反馈，操作失败时用户毫不知情
risk_points_en: Removing SL/TP eliminates all risk protection on positions, exposing them to unlimited losses
No confirmation mechanism — a misclick removes all protection instantly
No error feedback — users remain completely unaware when operations fail

summary_en: This EA provides a GUI button labeled 'DELETE SL_TP' that removes stop loss and take profit levels from all open positions when clicked. It iterates through all positions and modifies each to set SL and TP to zero, effectively removing all protection levels. The EA does not open any trades on its own.
